dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Look up, Nam! Those are bats. Thousands of them live in this cave.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk ˈʌp, ˈnɑːm! ðoʊz ər ˈbæts. ˈθaʊzəndz əv ðɛm ˈlɪv ɪn ðɪs ˈkeɪv.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. Most of them sleep in the day. They fly out at sunset.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈmoʊst əv ðɛm ˈsliːp ɪn ðə ˈdeɪ. ðeɪ ˈflaɪ ˈaʊt ət ˈsʌnsɛt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Some of them eat fruit, but most of them eat insects, like mosquitoes.
dialogue.reading: sʌm əv ðɛm ˈiːt ˈfruːt, bʌt ˈmoʊst əv ðɛm ˈiːt ˈɪnsɛkts, ˈlaɪk məˈskiːtoʊz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good! I hate mosquitoes. Are there any spiders in here?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd! aɪ ˈheɪt məˈskiːtoʊz. ər ðɛr ˈɛni ˈspaɪdərz ɪn ˈhɪr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: A few. But none of them are dangerous.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈfjuː. bʌt ˈnʌn əv ðɛm ər ˈdeɪndʒərəs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What's that up there? Is it a nest?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌts ðæt ˈʌp ˈðɛr? ɪz ɪt ə ˈnɛst?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's a bird's nest. And listen! Can you hear the frogs outside?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ə ˈbɜːrdz ˈnɛst. ənd ˈlɪsən! kən juː ˈhɪr ðə ˈfrɔːɡz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! Some of them are so noisy!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! sʌm əv ðɛm ər ˈsoʊ ˈnɔɪzi!
